blocks.html:
The constructor allows you to access resources from the module's container using the first parameter,
and the module's options using the second parameter.

If you're creating a client or establishing a connection with a third-party service, do it in the constructor.

This method executes a given asynchronous job with a lock on the given keys. The Locking Module uses this method
when you call its `execute` method and your provider is the default provider, or you pass your provider's identifier to its `execute` method.

In the method, you should first try to acquire the lock on the given keys before the specified timeout passes.
Then, once the lock is acquired, you execute the job. Otherwise, if the timeout passes before the lock is acquired, you cancel the job.

types.name: T
types.description: The type of the job's result.

types.name: keys
types.description: The keys to lock during the job's execution.

types.name: job
types.description: The asynchronous job to execute while the keys are locked.

types.name: args
types.description: Additional arguments for the job execution.

children.name: timeout
children.description: The timeout (in seconds) for acquiring the lock. If the time out is passed, the job is canceled and the lock is released.

types.name: sharedContext
types.description: A context used to share resources, such as transaction manager, between the application and the module.

children.name: transactionManager
children.description: An instance of a transaction manager of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `transactionManager`.

children.name: manager
children.description: An instance of a manager, typically an entity manager, of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `manager`.

children.name: isolationLevel
children.description: A string indicating the isolation level of the context. Possible values are `READ UNCOMMITTED`, `READ COMMITTED`, `REPEATABLE READ`, or `SERIALIZABLE`.

children.name: enableNestedTransactions
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether nested transactions are enabled.

children.name: eventGroupId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the group to aggregate the events to be emitted at a later point.

children.name: transactionId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current transaction.

children.name: runId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current run.

children.name: messageAggregator
children.description: An instance of a message aggregator, which is used to aggregate messages to be emitted at a later point.

children.name: requestId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current request.

children.name: idempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the current workflow execution.

children.name: parentStepIdempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the parent workflow execution.

children.name: preventReleaseEvents
children.description: preventReleaseEvents

children.name: isCancelling
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether the current workflow execution is being cancelled.

children.description:
Weither or not a sub workflow cancellation is being triggered from a parent step.
If true, the parent step will not be triggered by the sub workflow.

blocks.html:
This method acquires a lock on the given keys. The Locking Module uses this method when you call its `acquire` method and your provider is the default provider,
or you pass your provider's identifier to its `acquire` method.

In this method, you should only aquire the lock if the timeout hasn't passed. As explained in the [execute](/references/types/interfaces/types.ILockingProvider#execute) method's example,
you can use a `cancellationToken` object to determine if the lock acquisition has timed out.

If the lock aquisition isn't canceled, you should aquire the lock, setting its expiry and owner. You should account for the following scenarios:

- The lock doesn't have an owner and you don't pass an owner, in which case the lock can be extended or released by anyone.
- The lock doesn't have an owner or has the same owner that you pass, in which case you can extend the lock's expiration time and set the owner.
- The lock has an owner, but you pass a different owner, in which case the method should throw an error.

types.name: keys
types.description: The keys to acquire the lock on.

types.name: args
types.description: Additional arguments for acquiring the lock.

children.name: ownerId
children.description: The ID of the lock's owner. If specified, only the owner can release the lock or extend its expiration time.

children.name: expire
children.description:
The expiration time (in seconds) for the lock. If the lock is already acquired and the owner is the same, the expiration time is extended
by the value passed. If not specified, the lock does not expire.

blocks.html:
This method releases a lock on the given keys. The Locking Module uses this method when you call its `release` method and your provider is the default provider,
or you pass your provider's identifier to its `release` method.

In this method, you should release the lock on the given keys. If the lock has an owner, you should only release the lock if the owner is the same as the one passed.

types.name: keys
types.description: The keys to release the lock from.

types.name: args
types.description: Additional arguments for releasing the lock.

children.name: ownerId
children.description:
The ID of the lock's owner. The lock can be released either if it doesn't have an owner, or
if its owner ID matches the one passed in this property.

blocks.html:
This method releases all locks. The Locking Module uses this method when you call its `releaseAll` method and your provider is the default provider,
or you pass your provider's identifier to its `releaseAll` method.

In this method, you should release all locks if no owner is passed. If an owner is passed, you should only release the locks that the owner has acquired.

types.name: args
types.description: Additional arguments for releasing the locks.

children.name: ownerId
children.description: The ID of a lock owner. If specified, all locks that the owner has acquired are released.
